artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\delta\in(0,1)$ be fixed. For a prime $p$, a multiplicative subgroup $H\le \mathbb{F}_p^{*}$ with $|H|>p^{\delta}$, and an integer $k\ge 1$, define
$$kH := \underbrace{H+H+\cdots+H}_{k\text{ summands}} = \{h_1+h_2+\cdots+h_k : h_i\in H\}.$$
Determine the smallest integer $k=k(\delta)\ge 1$ such that for every prime $p$ and every multiplicative subgroup $H\le \mathbb{F}_p^{*}$ with $|H|>p^{\delta}$ one has $kH=\mathbb{F}_p$. In particular, determine the optimal order of growth of $k(\delta)$ as $\delta\to 0^{+}$. It is known that $k(\delta)$ can be taken with $\log k\le C/\delta$ for some absolute constant $C$, and that $k\le C^{4/\delta}$ suffices; can these bounds be improved?
artifact.category_tag: Sumsets of multiplicative subgroups in prime fields
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining the optimal k = k(δ) such that kH = F_p for any multiplicative subgroup H with |H| > p^δ remains an active topic. Subsequent works by Bourgain–Glibichuk–Konyagin and others give exponential-sum and sumset bounds, and further refinements have appeared (e.g., on exponential sums over small subgroups and on whether small subgroups can be sumsets), but the precise minimal k(δ) and its sharp asymptotic as δ → 0 do not appear to be settled.

status_evidence.title: Exponential sums over small subgroups, revisited
status_evidence.snippet: Revisits and improves exponential sum estimates over small multiplicative subgroups in F_p.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to refine bounds related to sumsets and exponential sums for small multiplicative subgroups, indicating the sharp answer is not closed.

status_evidence.title: Any small multiplicative subgroup is not a sumset
status_evidence.snippet: For |Γ| ≤ p^{2/3−ε}, Γ is not a sumset B+C with |B|,|C|>1.
status_evidence.claim: Related structural results on multiplicative subgroups as sumsets have appeared, but they do not resolve the optimal k(δ) for kH = F_p.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems on Exponential and Character Sums (Shparlinski)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems related to subgroups in F_p and sumsets/exponential sums.
status_evidence.claim: The optimal k(δ) for kH = F_p is listed among unresolved questions in surveys on the area.
